sloka: ताम् दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सर्वे जनकस्य पुरीम् शुभाम् ।साधु साधु इति शंसन्तो मिथिलाम् समपूजयन् ॥१-४८-११॥
transliteration: tām dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve janakasya purīm śubhām ।sādhu sādhu iti śaṁsanto mithilām samapūjayan ॥1-48-11॥

translations.english: At the sight of an old uninhabited, beautiful and desolate hermitage in a grove near Mithila, the descendant of the Raghus enquired of the foremost among the ascetics (Viswamitra):
